name: load_skill
description: Read the full instructions (SKILL.md) for one of the available skills. Call it before following a skill for the first time in a conversation.

name: geocode
description: Convert a US place name (city, town, beach, or NOAA gauge name) to latitude/longitude.

name: stations_within_radius
description: List NOAA CO-OPS water-level tide gauges within a radius of a point, nearest first, with great-circle distance in miles.

name: list_stations_in_state
description: List all NOAA water-level tide gauges in a US state or territory.

name: get_sea_level_trend
description: Fetch NOAA monthly mean sea level for a gauge and year range (cached for 10 days), remove the seasonal cycle, and fit a linear trend. Returns coverage, trend (mm/yr) with 95% CI corrected for autocorrelation, and record months. The series is kept in the page for plotting.

name: get_long_term_trend
description: NOAA's official long-term relative sea level trend for a gauge (multi-decade linear fit, mm/yr with 95% CI, start and end year). Use it to put a short-window trend in context.

name: plot_stations
description: Plot seasonal-anomaly time series and trend lines for up to 4 gauges already fetched with get_sea_level_trend, and show their trend bars. Call once with all gauges to compare.
